nodes.name: Access360 - Get Branch And Company ID

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE access360_processed_attendance (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    access360_id BIGINT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    employee_id VARCHAR(255),
    event_type VARCHAR(50),
    event_time TIMESTAMP,
    processed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all();

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO access360_processed_attendance (
    access360_id,
    employee_id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    destination_attendance_id
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.access360_id }},
    '{{ String($json.employee_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.event_type ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.event_time }}'::timestamptz,
    {{ $json.destination_attendance_id }}
)
ON CONFLICT (access360_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT
    id,
    access360_id,
    employee_id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    processed_at,
    destination_attendance_id
FROM access360_processed_attendance WHERE employee_id = '50214'
ORDER BY processed_at DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(access360_id), 0) AS last_unique_id
FROM access360_processed_attendance;

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM access360_processed_attendance
        WHERE access360_id = 51290614
    ) AS already_processed_1,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM access360_processed_attendance
        WHERE access360_id = 51290615
    ) AS already_processed_2;

SELECT
    id,
    access360_id,
    employee_id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    processed_at,
    destination_attendance_id
FROM access360_processed_attendance
ORDER BY processed_at DESC;
